run_generate_enums: run generate_enums.py with a Clang AST JSON file to produce Python enums module
build_enum_visitor: build a MjEnumVisitor to traverse Clang AST JSON and extract MuJoCo enum declarations
traverse_ast: traverse a Clang AST JSON node tree with a visitor pattern to collect enum data
make_enum_decl: make an EnumDecl from a Clang AST EnumConstantDecl node with auto-incremented values
summarize_main: summarize the main CLI entry point that reads Clang AST JSON and prints generated enums.py
